description: Regression proof for registering CMS record 35669 (DYJetsToLL_M-50, the Z->ee control region's DY simulation) in services.parsing.schemas.RECORD_ID_TO_SCHEMA as 'cms-nanoaod' -- the Z->ee pilot's DY subjobs failed with 'record ID 35669 ... is not registered' before this fix (the 8 H->gamma-gamma records were registered when task 6 started, but 35669 was only found and used later, in the Z->ee follow-up task, and was missed at that time). Same method as every prior addition to this mapping: FileParser._parse_opened_file run on real files, once with schemas.py BEFORE this addition (git stash of just that one file) and once AFTER (working tree with the addition), same repo checkout otherwise.
commit_under_test: 857f23c (feature/hgg-selection-and-output, HEAD at the start of this fix)

atlas_2024r-pp.reason: This laptop environment has no XRootD/rucio client installed (fsspec_xrootd/XRootD both absent -- confirmed directly) and ATLAS rucio storage has no plain-HTTPS mirror equivalent to CERN Open Data's opendata.cern.ch redirector used for the 4 CMS files above, so this file could not be opened from here. Not re-run, not assumed passing by default -- the four CMS comparisons above WERE run for real, live, this session.

why_atlas_is_still_safe_by_construction: This change adds exactly one new dict entry (35669: 'cms-nanoaod') to RECORD_ID_TO_SCHEMA and touches no other line, no other file. It cannot affect ATLAS's own 'record_2024r-pp'-keyed schema lookup or any other already-registered record's lookup -- a dict lookup for an existing key is unaffected by an unrelated key being added. This is the identical reasoning the original 8-record H->gamma-gamma registration's own regression proof already used and verified for the ATLAS path specifically (schema_registration_regression_results.json's own 'atlas_2024r-pp: IDENTICAL' result, for the exact same class of change) -- not re-derived here, but not a new assumption either.
notes: Schema registration only adds a dict entry for a record ID none of the 4 CMS test files/records use, so it cannot affect their output by construction -- confirmed directly (not just assumed) for the 4 CMS files above.
UnregisteredRecordSchemaError's new-error-path behavior is unchanged for these 4 records -- all were already registered before this fix, so that path is not reached by them either way.

record_schema_evidence.json's own '35669' entry documents the direct branch-format check (flat NanoAOD naming, run/luminosityBlock/event and genWeight all present) that justified adding this record as 'cms-nanoaod' in the first place.
overall_verdict: IDENTICAL for all 4 CMS datasets (verified live, this session); ATLAS path unaffected by construction, consistent with the identical reasoning already verified for the original 8-record registration -- not independently re-run this session due to no rucio/XRootD access from this environment.
